title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 21: Zedekiah's messengers, the way of life and the way of death, and the word to the house of David.

questions.text: Whom did king Zedekiah send to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah sent to Jeremiah Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest.

answers.text: Ahikam the son of Shaphan and Elnathan the son of Achbor
Pashhur the son of Malchijah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah
Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah
Hananiah the son of Azzur and Shemaiah the Nehelamite

questions.text: What did the messengers ask Jeremiah to do for them?
questions.explanation: They said, "Please inquire of Yahweh for us," because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon was making war against them.

answers.text: Write a letter to Babylon
Anoint a new king for Judah
Gather the priests to offer sacrifice
Inquire of Yahweh for them

questions.text: What did Yahweh say He would do with the weapons of war that were in their hands?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would turn back the weapons of war with which they fought against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans, and gather them into the middle of the city.

answers.text: Turn them back and gather them into the middle of the city
Make them strong against the Chaldeans
Break them in pieces outside the walls
Send them away to the king of Egypt

questions.text: Of what did Yahweh say the inhabitants of the city, both man and animal, would die?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal, and they would die of a great pestilence.

answers.text: Of thirst
Of fire from heaven
Of a great pestilence
Of wild animals

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh say He would deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants and the people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would deliver Zedekiah, his servants and the people into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies.

answers.text: Into the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt
Into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
Into the hand of the kings of the Medes
Into the hand of the king of Edom

questions.text: What two ways did Yahweh say He set before this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death."

answers.text: The way of life and the way of death
The way of the wise and the way of the fool
The way of war and the way of peace
The way of the rich and the way of the poor

questions.text: According to verse 9, who would live and escape with his life?
questions.explanation: The one who remained in the city would die by the sword, famine and pestilence, but the one who went out and passed over to the Chaldeans who besieged the city would live and escape with his life.

answers.text: Whoever stayed inside the city of Jerusalem
Whoever hid in the rock of the plain
Whoever fled away to the king of Egypt
Whoever went out to the Chaldeans who besieged the city

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the king of Babylon would do to the city once it was given into his hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He had set his face on the city for evil and not for good, that it would be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and that he would burn it with fire.

answers.text: Rebuild its walls
Leave it empty but standing
Burn it with fire
Set his own son over it as king

questions.text: What was the house of David told to do in the morning?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told the house of David to execute justice in the morning and to deliver the one who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, so that his wrath would not go out like fire.

answers.text: Offer a burnt offering in the temple
Execute justice and deliver the one who is robbed
Call all the people together to fast
Send tribute to the king of Babylon

questions.text: According to verse 14, by what measure would Yahweh punish them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings," and that He would kindle a fire in her forest which would devour all around her.

answers.text: According to the fruit of their doings
According to the number of their years
According to the words of their prophets
According to the size of their city
